title: SEG Verifies Edge
description: Schema for a Verifies edge in the Safety Evidence Graph. Direction: TestSpecification → Requirement. The test specification declares what it verifies via the @verifies doxygen tag. Many-to-many supported — one test spec may verify multiple requirements, one requirement may be verified by multiple test specs. Strong-propagation edge: a change to either endpoint marks this edge suspect and notifies both the Requirements Engineer and the Test Engineer. The seg:subHashChanged field on the resulting ReviewEvent distinguishes whether specHash or implHash changed. Resolution requires human affirmation; a new test run is also required if implHash changed.

seg:from.description: IRI of the TestSpecification node — the one that verifies.

seg:to.description: IRI of the Requirement node — the one being verified.
